lines.en: I swim through the air; I do not walk.

lines.zh: 触须在水里是桨，在岸上是腿。
lines.en: Tentacles row in water, walk on land.
I drift along, dripping seawater.
My motions are slower than water.
A trail of slime follows me.
I do not tread; I slide over the ground.

lines.zh: 往深处去，光越少越舒服。
lines.en: Go deeper; less light suits me better.

lines.zh: 我的触须先探到前面去了。
lines.en: My tentacles have reached ahead already.
Every step brings a sound of water.
I glide when I move and drift when tired.
Do not step in the wet trail I leave.
I look heavy, yet one push sends me drifting.

lines.zh: 我闭着眼，听水底的声音。
lines.en: Eyes closed, I listen to the deep.
Tentacles curl and uncurl slowly.

lines.zh: 我在想那片没去过的海沟。
lines.en: I am thinking of a trench I never reached.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在暗处发微光。
lines.en: My scales give a faint glow in the dark.
In quiet, I hear the tide.
I curl myself into a ball of water.
The things in my dreams are more real than this.

lines.zh: 我在数自己有几条触须。
lines.en: I am counting how many tentacles I have.

lines.zh: 有些名字我不能念出来。
lines.en: There are names I must not speak.

lines.zh: 我贴在墙上，像一块湿的布。
lines.en: I cling to the wall like wet cloth.
Breathing is only a habit for me.
I am waiting for my master to run out of air.
The water is quiet; this place is loud.

lines.zh: 越黑的地方，我瞳孔越亮。
lines.en: The darker it gets, the brighter my pupils.

lines.zh: 我在数主人还剩多少口气。
lines.en: I am counting how many breaths my master has left.

lines.zh: 水里的光晃了晃，我睁眼。
lines.en: The light in the water shifts and I open my eyes.
To my eye, you look like a fish.
I hear your lungs working.
Do not fear; my gaze does not bite.
I can let you breathe beneath the water.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水里会好看些。
lines.en: Your shadow would look better underwater.

lines.zh: 我正把你的呼吸记下来。
lines.en: I am memorizing the way you breathe.

lines.zh: 你脸色发青，是憋气了吗。
lines.en: You are turning blue; holding your breath?

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，水会退一点。
lines.en: When I watch you, the water draws back a little.
You carry the smell of salt.

lines.zh: 再靠近些，我看看你的眼。
lines.en: Come closer; let me see your eyes.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔是竖的，别介意。
lines.en: My pupils are vertical; pay it no mind.
Master, your hands are shaking.

lines.zh: 我看得见你身后的深水。
lines.en: I can see the deep water behind you.
Stare too long and you will want to sleep.
You cut into my soft flesh.
What leaks from me is like seawater.

lines.zh: 触须断了两条，我还剩很多。
lines.en: Two tentacles are severed; I have many left.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我会缩成一团。
lines.en: In pain, I curl into a knot.
Do not touch the wound; it is bubbling.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被捞上来时。
lines.en: This recalls being hauled up in a net.
My gills flutter; I cannot get air.

lines.zh: 你砍的不是骨头，是软骨。
lines.en: You cut not bone but cartilage.
Pain made me spit out ink.
A night in water will mend this.
Fish is fine; keep the dry rations.
I eat little; something salty suffices.
This fish is still flapping; perfect.

lines.zh: 你举着鱼，我触须都醒了。
lines.en: With that fish raised, all my tentacles wake.
Kelp will do; I am not particular.
Do not feed me bread; I will choke.
More water, less food.
This mouthful keeps me sunk all day.

lines.zh: 手再往前，吸盘就过去了。
lines.en: One inch closer and my suckers reach you.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，眼睛会发绿。
lines.en: When hungry, my eyes turn green.
One touch leaves your palm dripping.

lines.zh: 我一身黏液，你手指打滑。
lines.en: I am all slime, and your fingers slide off.

lines.zh: 别撞，我的触须会缠上来。
lines.en: Do not bump me; my tentacles will wrap.
That felt like a wave pushing me.
Being soft does not mean I am easy.
Back away; you are crushing my gills.
The knock made me spit out a mouthful.

lines.zh: 我在水里从不会撞到东西。
lines.en: In water, I never bump into anything.
Excuse me; I move slowly.
Push again and I will climb your shoulder.
I have kin enough in the water.
What happens in the deep needs no detail.

lines.zh: 使魔不谈这个，只谈契约。
lines.en: Familiars do not speak of that, only of pacts.

lines.zh: 我产卵的记忆不属于这里。
lines.en: The memory of spawning does not belong here.
That question made my tentacles retract.

lines.zh: 深海里有更古老的东西。
lines.en: Older things live in the deep.
My kind needs no partners.

lines.zh: 召唤出来的，回不去海里。
lines.en: Summoned ones cannot return to the sea.

lines.zh: 别替我操心，我活得够久。
lines.en: Do not worry for me; I have lived long.
Ask me when I sink back down.
I curl a tentacle around it, firmly.
Things in the water, I will gather.
This shell is mine.

lines.zh: 我抱着它，像抱着一颗卵。
lines.en: I hold it as if it were an egg.
Do not pull; my suckers have it.
It is wet now, good for carrying back.
I pick things up without a sound.
There is seaweed on this stone.
I will keep it; it may be of use.
Give it here; I will set it by the water.
That thing is panting by the shore.
It is slower than I; it will not escape.
I can see the air in its lungs.

lines.zh: 深海的东西也想上来吃饭。
lines.en: Things from the deep want to feed too.
It stepped in my wet trail.
Wrap the legs first, then climb.
It carries the smell of fish.
This prey is no small thing; enough.

lines.zh: 别靠近水，它在那里更弱。
lines.en: Stay from the water; it is weaker there.
All my tentacles point at it.
It thinks the water is safe; wrong.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地过去，不惊动它。
lines.en: I close in quietly so it never notices.
Target chosen; master, step back.

lines.zh: 它听见水声了，已经晚了。
lines.en: It heard the water; too late.
I wait for it to lower its head and drink.
My tentacles spread like a net.
One step closer and it is in the water.
Its breathing falters; I wait for it.
Make no sound; water carries word.
It turned; so did I.

lines.zh: 我把身体压扁，藏进水影。
lines.en: I flatten myself into the shadow of the water.
When it missteps, I strike.
Three steps left; very close.
Its shadow enters the water first.
I hold my breath, though I need not.
A tentacle tip waits behind its ankle.
It is starting to panic; perfect.
This one cannot miss.

lines.zh: 它没注意到水面的波纹。
lines.en: It has not noticed the ripples on the water.
I wrap its ankle and drag it toward water.

lines.zh: 吸盘贴住皮肤，拔不下来。
lines.en: Suckers take hold of skin and will not come off.
All my strength lives in my tentacles.
It thrashes the surface and sinks faster.
The blow is silent, only water sounds.
I press it under, very gently.
It grabs the bank; I pull it back.

lines.zh: 我不咬，只要它喘不上气。
lines.en: I do not bite; I only need it breathless.
The tentacles tighten like a drawn net.
After that blow, the water went cloudy.

lines.zh: 召唤阵里先涌出一摊水。
lines.en: Water wells up out of the circle first.
I crawl out of the wet ink.

lines.zh: 这具身体还带着海腥味。
lines.en: This body still smells of the sea.

lines.zh: 主人，你准备好下水了吗。
lines.en: Master, are you ready to go under?
The air is too dry; my gills tighten.

lines.zh: 我认得这个祭坛的石头。
lines.en: I know the stone of this altar.

lines.zh: 粉笔线被我的水泡糊了。
lines.en: My bubbles smeared the chalk lines.
Dreams from below sent me up.
Let me get wet first, then I work.

lines.zh: 升级过的我，能照亮海沟。
lines.en: Upgraded, I can light up a trench.
The pact makes only a small water sound.
My tentacles just unfurled; do not step on them.

lines.zh: 这里有盐吗，我需要一点。
lines.en: Is there salt here? I need a little.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里浮起来，很慢。
lines.en: I rise out of the dark, slowly.

lines.zh: 火烤干我的皮，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Fire dries my skin; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 摔到硬地上，水都震出来了。
lines.en: I hit hard ground and the water shook out.

lines.zh: 我自己也会溺水，很荒唐。
lines.en: I can drown too; it is absurd.
The blast pasted me against the wall.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的触须里，沉甸甸的。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my tentacle, heavy.
Magic burned my gills.
With no fish to eat, I grow transparent.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水爬满了我全身。
lines.en: Lightning crawled all over me through water.

lines.zh: 虚空是干的，比深海还空。
lines.en: The void is dry, emptier than the deep.
